resource: Item entries of one MapTileV1 (the cut of a composed tile stack)
allocation_impact: The bottom entry and the 9 topmost of the composed stack; a stack of more than 10 entries sets more. Each entry is at most 32 bytes, a tile at most 360 bytes in its field.
boundary_tests: max=10: a 10-entry tile with the largest values encodes within 360 bytes and decodes
max+1=11: a tile with 11 items fails closed
notes: MAP-WIRE-1 §2 and §3. Tests: world_map::tests::encoded_sizes_stay_within_the_bounds, world_map::tests::every_malformed_tile_and_snapshot_fails_closed. Registered by OTV2-20261004-map-wire-2.
